thread:
andrea (Marketing): Quick FYI — HelixOps SI final assets landed in Drive. We need: logo lockup, 2-sentence customer quote, short alt text, and the solution brief PDF for marketplace listing. Can design/brand confirm we’re good for co-branding? link: https://drive.google.com/helixops-assets :raised_hands:

li (Design): Downloading now. Do we have HelixOps brand guidelines? I only see a logo + color swatches. Need spacing/clearspace rules.

andrea (Marketing): They sent a one-pager with rules but it’s messy. I pulled a cleaner version in the folder named `HelixOps_brand_guidelines_v2.pdf` — check `marketing/helixops/brand`.

li (Design): Quick ask — can we get SVG of their lockup (logo + product badge) rather than PNGs? SVGs make the marketplace thumbnails crisp. If not, I can vector trace but prefer original.

tom (Partnerships): HelixOps confirmed they can provide SVG. I pinged their design lead. ETA today. Also confirming the case study quote — they want to use a line from CTO Sarah Meng: "Redwood made inference predictable at scale." Is that cleared?

jules (Legal): We need written approval from HelixOps for that exact quote. If they want to attribute to the CTO, we need an explicit signoff email. Also check trademark usage rules in their guidelines.

andrea (Marketing): Noted. I already asked for quote sign-off in the same thread with HelixOps PM. Will add reply when they confirm.

li (Design): While we wait, I made a quick variant of the thumbnail using our standard 1:1 lockup and placeholder alt text. Preview: `![](/images/mockups/helixops-thumb-v1.png)` — feedback?

tom (Partnerships): Looks good, but swap HelixOps primary blue for the slightly darker hex in their file (they call it `Helix Blue Dark`). Also ensure our Redwood wordmark is consistent with co-brand spacing guidelines.

li (Design): Will update spacing to 24px clearspace on small thumbnails per their doc. Also adding focus state and an accessible alt: "HelixOps + Redwood Inference joint solution for inference orchestration". Thoughts?

andrea (Marketing): Alt is fine but shorten to: "HelixOps and Redwood solution for inference orchestration" — marketplace has strict character limits.

jules (Legal): Confirmed: we should also include a short IP attribution footer in the solution brief PDF: "HelixOps and Redwood trademarks are the property of their respective owners." Please add before publish.

marketplace-bot: Marketplace listing scheduled: draft created for partner `helixops-redwood-solution` — review required. (automated)

li (Design): Updated thumbnails + alt text pushed to `marketing/helixops/figma` (file `thumbs_v2`). I added comments for the 16x9 export sizes.

andrea (Marketing): Thanks — once we have SVG + quote sign-off + legal blurb added to PDF, I’ll request final review and then hit publish. Targeting Tuesday publish window. :calendar:

tom (Partnerships): Reconfirming timeline with HelixOps: they can sign off tomorrow morning. If that slips, fallback plan is to publish marketplace listing with note "quote pending" and push the quote as an update. OK with ops?

jules (Legal): Fine with publish-if-pending as long as quote placeholder is clearly marked and we have a tracked task to replace it. Also keep the signed quote email attached to the listing audit log.

andrea (Marketing): I'll create a tiny checklist in the Drive root: `1) SVG lockup 2) Signed quote 3) Alt text 4) Legal footer 5) PDF export` and tag everyone.

li (Design): One last check — HelixOps uses a gradient on their lockup in some contexts. For marketplace we should use flat color variant to avoid color-shift on thumbnails. I left both in the folder with naming `logo-flat.svg` and `logo-gradient.svg`.

andrea (Marketing): Perfect. Assigning publish task to me. I’ll loop back here once HelixOps confirms quote. :thumbsup:
